articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: Stock Market Today: Nasdaq Gets Hit Hardest As Techs Sink; Palantir Climbs After Earnings Report (Live Coverage). Stocks closed Tuesday's session on the losing side with the Nasdaq hit hardest as investors sold tech stocks and sought defensive names while Wall Street read over a slew of quarterly reports. PayPal crumbled on the stock market today after its earnings report, while blue-chip Walmart hit a market milestone. The Nasdaq closed with a 1.4% loss. Related tickers mentioned: FN, IBM, PLTR, PYPL, RMBS, WMT, ^DJI, ^GSPC, ^IXIC.
